# Widget strings

The 113 strings the widget shows, in British English. A project overrides them on the dashboard's Widget page, Strings tab (plans with custom strings: Basic, Professional and Enterprise). Code may pass `init({ strings })` too; the project's overrides win over it, and both apply only with that entitlement.

| Key | Default | Where it appears |
|---|---|---|
| `launcher.open` | Open help | The launcher button's name for screen readers while the panel is closed |
| `launcher.label` | Help | The label beside the launcher's mark, when the label is switched on |
| `launcher.close` | Close help | The launcher button's name for screen readers while the panel is open |
| `launcher.unread` | {count} unread | The launcher's unread badge, for screen readers |
| `panel.title` | Help | The panel's name for screen readers when the project has no name |
| `panel.close` | Close | The panel's close button, for screen readers |
| `panel.loading` | Loading… | The panel while the widget's settings load |
| `tabs.label` | Help sections | The tab list's name, for screen readers |
| `tabs.ask` | Ask | The Ask tab |
| `tabs.request` | New request | The New request tab |
| `tabs.requests` | Your requests | The Your requests tab |
| `ask.greeting` | Hi, I'm {name}. Ask me anything about {product}. | The Ask tab's greeting when the assistant has a name |
| `ask.greetingProject` | Hi, this is {project}. Ask us anything about {product}. | The Ask tab's greeting with the project's and the product's names |
| `ask.greetingProjectOnly` | Hi, this is {project}. Ask us anything. | The Ask tab's greeting with the project's name only |
| `ask.note` | Answers come from {project}'s documentation. | The line under the Ask tab's greeting |
| `ask.placeholder` | Ask a question | The question box's placeholder |
| `ask.counter` | {count} of {max} characters | The characters counter under the question box |
| `ask.send` | Send | The Send button for a question |
| `ask.stop` | Stop | The Stop button while an answer is written |
| `ask.stopped` | Stopped. | After an answer the person stopped |
| `ask.thinking` | Thinking… | While the assistant starts its answer |
| `ask.searching` | Searching the documentation… | While the assistant searches the documentation |
| `ask.reading` | Reading the documentation… | While the assistant reads the pages it found |
| `ask.read` | Read: | Before the list of pages an answer used |
| `ask.helpful` | Helpful | The thumbs-up button on an answer, for screen readers |
| `ask.notHelpful` | Not helpful | The thumbs-down button on an answer, for screen readers |
| `ask.whatWasMissing` | What was missing? | The comment box after a thumbs-down |
| `ask.sendComment` | Send | The button that sends that comment |
| `ask.thanks` | Thanks for telling us. | After feedback is sent |
| `ask.handOff` | Send a request about this | The link from an answer to New request |
| `ask.newConversation` | New conversation | The button that starts a new conversation |
| `ask.turnLimit` | This conversation is full. Start a new one to keep asking. | When a conversation has reached its length |
| `ask.retry` | Try again | The button after an answer failed |
| `ask.errorGeneric` | Sorry, I could not answer that. | When an answer failed |
| `ask.capReached` | The assistant is paused this month. Send a request instead. | When the project's monthly answers are used |
| `ask.unavailable` | The assistant is not available right now. Send a request instead. | When the assistant cannot answer: no usable key or model (a 503) |
| `ask.dailyLimit` | You have asked a lot today. Send a request instead, or try again tomorrow. | When the person has asked their daily limit |
| `ask.cutShort` | This answer was cut short. | Under an answer that ended early |
| `ask.refused` | I can't help with that one. You can send a request instead. | When the assistant declines a question |
| `ask.offline` | You're offline. Check your connection and try again. | When the browser is offline |
| `ask.signInToAsk` | Sign in to ask questions. | When the server refuses a question (forbidden) |
| `ask.answerReady` | Answer ready | Announced to screen readers when an answer is complete |
| `request.kind` | What is it about? | The question above the request kinds in New request |
| `request.message` | Message | The message box's label in New request |
| `request.placeholder.problem` | What happened, and what did you expect? | The message box's placeholder for a Problem, unless the kind has its own |
| `request.placeholder.question` | What would you like to know? | The message box's placeholder for a Question, unless the kind has its own |
| `request.placeholder.idea` | What would make this better? | The message box's placeholder for an Idea, unless the kind has its own |
| `request.placeholder.other` | Tell the team what you need. | The message box's placeholder for any other kind without its own |
| `request.counter` | {count} of {max} characters | The characters counter under the message box |
| `request.capture` | Capture this tab | The button that captures the current browser tab as a screenshot |
| `request.capturePrompt` | Choose this tab in the browser prompt | The hint while the browser asks which tab to capture |
| `request.captureCancel` | Cancel | The button that cancels a tab capture in progress |
| `request.choose` | Choose a screenshot | The button that picks an image file to attach |
| `request.shotOpen` | Open {name} | A screenshot tile's name, for screen readers, that opens it full size |
| `request.shotUploading` | Uploading {name} | A screenshot tile while it uploads, for screen readers |
| `request.shotRetry` | Try again | The button on a screenshot that failed to upload |
| `request.shotRemove` | Remove {name} | The button that removes a screenshot before sending |
| `request.shotsMax` | Up to 4 screenshots on one request. | When a fifth screenshot is added |
| `request.shotTooBig` | That image is over 8 MB. | When a chosen image is larger than the upload limit |
| `request.shotType` | Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image. | When a chosen file is not a supported image |
| `request.blocking` | This is stopping me from working | The tick box for a request that stops the person working |
| `request.email` | Your email | The email field's label, when the widget asks for one |
| `request.emailHint` | So the team can reply by email as well as here. | The line under the email field |
| `request.emailInvalid` | Enter an email address, such as name@example.com. | When the email address is not valid |
| `request.context` | What we send with it | The heading over what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.page` | Page | The page's address, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.title` | Page title | The page's title, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.browser` | Browser | The browser, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.language` | Language | The browser's language, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.timeZone` | Time zone | The time zone, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.window` | Window | The window's size, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.screen` | Screen | The screen's size, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.pixelRatio` | Pixel ratio | The screen's pixel ratio, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.context.error` | Error | The error the page reported, in what is sent with a request |
| `request.removeError` | Remove the error | The button that leaves the error out of a request |
| `request.answer` | Your question and the assistant's answer go with it. | When a question and the assistant's answer go with the request |
| `request.removeAnswer` | Remove the answer | The button that leaves the question and answer out |
| `request.send` | Send request | The button that sends a request |
| `request.sending` | Sending… | The send button while a request is sent |
| `request.limit` | Requests are paused for this month. Try again later. | When the project's requests for the month are used |
| `request.failed` | Your request was not sent. Try again. | When a request was not sent |
| `request.offline` | You're offline. Check your connection and try again. | When the browser is offline, in New request |
| `request.sent` | Request sent. | The heading after a request is sent |
| `request.sentReference` | Your reference is {reference}. | The request's reference, after it is sent |
| `request.sentByEmail` | We will reply by email to {email} and here. | After sending, when the team will also reply by email |
| `request.sentHere` | We will reply here. | After sending, when the team will reply in the widget only |
| `request.replyTime` | We usually reply within a day. | After sending, how soon the team usually replies, in the project's own words |
| `request.view` | View request | The button that opens the request just sent |
| `request.another` | Send another | The button that starts another request |
| `requests.empty` | You have not sent a request yet. | Your requests when the person has sent none |
| `requests.emptyAction` | Send a request | The button from an empty Your requests to New request |
| `requests.failed` | Your requests could not be loaded. | When the person's requests could not be loaded |
| `requests.retry` | Try again | The button after the requests or a request failed to load |
| `requests.more` | Show more | The button that loads more requests |
| `requests.closed` | Closed ({count}) | The heading over the closed requests, with their count |
| `requests.status.sent` | Sent | The status of a request the team has not answered |
| `requests.status.replied` | Replied | The status of a request the team has answered |
| `requests.status.closed` | Closed | The status of a closed request |
| `requests.blocking` | Blocking | The tag on a request that stops the person working |
| `requests.unread` | New reply | The dot on a request with a new reply, for screen readers |
| `requests.back` | All requests | The button from a request back to the list |
| `requests.you` | You | The person's own messages in a request |
| `requests.team` | Team | The team's messages when the staff member has no name |
| `requests.threadFailed` | This request could not be loaded. | When a request could not be loaded |
| `requests.closedNote` | This request is closed. Reply to reopen it. | Under a closed request, above the reply box |
| `requests.replyPlaceholder` | Write a reply | The reply box's placeholder |
| `requests.reply` | Reply | The button that sends a reply |
| `requests.replyFailed` | Your reply was not sent. Try again. | When a reply was not sent |
| `requests.addShot` | Add a screenshot | The button that adds a screenshot to a reply |
| `requests.shotsMax` | Up to 4 screenshots on one reply. | When a fifth screenshot is added to a reply |
| `requests.download` | Download {name} | A file on a reply that is not an image, as a download link |
| `lightbox.close` | Close | The button that closes a screenshot shown full size |
| `footer.poweredBy` | Powered by Opem | The Powered by Opem badge's name, for screen readers |
